items.title: QUBE launches 355-home Sawa Residences on Meydan Horizon lagoon
items.summary: A lower-density development of 355 one- to three-bedroom apartments fronting the 2 km lagoon and 4 km promenade in MBR City, part of QUBE's AED 7.5 billion pipeline. The release gives no price or handover date; listing sites vary, so confirm both with the developer.

items.title: MERED releases second phase of Riviera Residences on Al Reem
items.summary: The Herzog & de Meuron-designed phase has 389 apartments, eight Bay Villas, six Sky Villas and a penthouse, with work due to start by year-end and completion targeted for Q2 2030. Listing sites quote from AED 2.2M; one tracker still shows pricing on request.

items.project: Mondrian Al Marjan Island Beach Residences – Mondrian Beach Villa
items.title: ELEVATE lists final Edit Collection home, an AED 50M beach villa
items.summary: The five-bedroom duplex of over 8,470 sq ft has a private pool and direct beach access, offered on a 35/65 plan. ELEVATE also says shoring and piling are complete and construction is ahead of schedule at the AED 1.4 billion project.

items.title: Omniyat opens first show residence at VELA in Marasi Bay
items.summary: The completed four-bedroom Marina Residence, with a private pool and terraces, gives buyers a first look inside the 38-residence Foster + Partners tower. Interiors are by Gilles & Boissier and Dorchester Collection will manage the residences.
